title: Agent Kannayiram
desc: A private detective, who runs his own agency, solves menial cases with the help of his assistant. However, things take a serious turn when a father wants him to investigate his daughter's murder.

title: Velaiilla Pattadhari 2
desc: Raghuvaran's career in civil engineering takes a tumultuous turn as he becomes embroiled in a fierce rivalry with Vasundhara, the powerful chairperson of a leading construction company.

title: Maaveeran
desc: After an accident, timid cartoonist Sathya begins to hear the voice of Maaveeran, a comic character he has created. Guided by Maaveeran, he takes a stand against a group of evil men.

title: Paayum Puli
desc: ACP Jayasheelan is on a mission to eliminate an extortion gang that spreads terror in Madurai. However, Jayasheelan is unaware that the mastermind behind the crimes is in his own house.

title: Kaappaan
desc: Kathiravan is assigned to protect Prime Minister Chandrakanth Varma from terrorists. However, he is unsuccessful and takes it upon himself to find the killers.
